basic_details.short_information: The National Productivity Council (NPC), an autonomous body under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, has invited applications for one Advisor post (Post Code Adv/01) on a purely contractual basis for 3 months at its Regional Directorate, Kolkata. Applications are sent by email to [email protected] on or before 15 November 2026, 3:00 PM, using the Annex-AF format.

qualification.details: Qualification: MBA in HR/Post Graduation in Industrial Engineering (IE). Required experience: at least 20 years of experience in Human Resource Management, Organization Behavior, HR Analytics, manpower assessment studies etc. Domain experience: adequate understanding of Government functioning, and the ability to facilitate coordination with the concerned departments, directorates and other offices of State Government; to provide technical and administrative guidance on government workflows and service delivery mechanisms; to ensure seamless execution of the study; and to oversee data compilation and report preparation to ensure administrative feasibility, technical soundness and overall quality of the study. Required skills: MS Word, MS Excel, MS Power Point, Data Analysis; Report Writing; Communication skills. Experience areas listed: data collection, MIS reporting and data analysis (data collection, analysis, MIS dashboards); report writing (preparing reports, presentations); reports finalization (discussions, presentations, preparing final reports). Own laptop: all candidates should have their own laptop for this job. No laptop will be provided by the organisation. Age limit: not specified in the notice. | The remuneration is the maximum of Rs.10,000 per day, subject to a maximum of 15 days a month, and depends on relevant experience and performance in selection process. The notice mentions a retired-person field in Annex-AF, so retired officers are covered by the form. For discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About NPC
content_sections.text: The notice describes the National Productivity Council as an autonomous body under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. It says NPC promotes productivity consciousness in the country for sustainable socio-economic development through productivity promotion and dissemination through consultancy, research and training activities in different sectors of the economy. The notice is issued from NPC at 5-6 Institutional Area, Lodhi Road, New Delhi, and NPC Headquarters (HQ), New Delhi invites the applications.

Required experience: at least 20 years of experience in Human Resource Management, Organization Behavior, HR Analytics, manpower assessment studies etc. Domain experience: adequate understanding of Government functioning, and the ability to facilitate coordination with the concerned departments, directorates and other offices of State Government; to provide technical and administrative guidance on government workflows and service delivery mechanisms; to ensure seamless execution of the study; and to oversee data compilation and report preparation to ensure administrative feasibility, technical soundness and overall quality of the study. Required skills: MS Word, MS Excel, MS Power Point, Data Analysis; Report Writing; Communication skills. Experience areas listed: data collection, MIS reporting and data analysis (data collection, analysis, MIS dashboards); report writing (preparing reports, presentations); reports finalization (discussions, presentations, preparing final reports). The remuneration is the maximum of Rs.10,000 per day, subject to a maximum of 15 days a month, and depends on relevant experience and performance in selection process. The notice mentions a retired-person field in Annex-AF, so retired officers are covered by the form. For discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.pay: Maximum Rs.10,000/- per day, subject to maximum of 15 days/month

content_sections.heading: NPC Advisor Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice says the Advisor would be expected to perform the following duties: Provide technical expertise on workflow structures and service delivery mechanisms to guide the study teams. Advise the study team on incorporating the impacts of upcoming policy changes, e-governance initiatives, automation, and future departmental expansions into the final manpower projections. Support between the study team and senior department leadership whenever necessary to get institutional support. To support the team wherever needed to support seamless flow of work. Oversee data compilation and provide critical inputs during the drafting of the study reports to ensure administrative viability and technical rigor.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application as per Annex-AF. Self-attested copy of proof of date of birth. Self-attested copy of Aadhar. Self-attested copies of educational/technical qualifications and all requisite documents. Duly filled APPENDIX (details of experience). Latest photo. Copy of PPO, in the case of a retired person, with the date of retirement and the name of the office where the officer was last working. Any other relevant information, on a separate sheet if necessary.

faq.question: Q1. How many Advisor posts has NPC announced for Kolkata?
faq.answer: NPC has announced 1 Advisor post (Post Code Adv/01) on a purely contractual basis, for deployment at the Regional Directorate, Kolkata.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NPC Advisor post?
faq.answer: The application must be sent by email on or before 15/11/2026 by 3:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NPC Advisor post?
faq.answer: The qualification is MBA in HR/Post Graduation in Industrial Engineering (IE).

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is required for the NPC Advisor post?
faq.answer: At least 20 years of experience is required in Human Resource Management, Organization Behavior, HR Analytics, manpower assessment studies etc.

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration for the NPC Advisor?
faq.answer: The remuneration is a maximum of Rs.10,000/- per day, subject to a maximum of 15 days/month, depending on relevant experience and performance in selection process.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NPC Advisor post?
faq.answer: Email the application as per Annex-AF with scans of self-attested copies of all requisite documents and a latest photo to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What should the email subject contain?
faq.answer: The subject must mention the name of the post applied for and the Advertisement No., which is 135.NPC/KOL/CONS/03/2026.

faq.question: Q8. Does NPC provide a laptop to the Advisor?
faq.answer: No. All candidates should have their own laptop for this job, and no laptop will be provided by the organisation.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Advisor be deployed?
faq.answer: The place of deployment is the Regional Directorate, Kolkata, and the field study covers PAN West Bengal.
